s = input()
ans = ""
used = False

def isDot(i):
    return s[i:i+3] == "dot"

def isAt(i):
    return s[i:i+2] == "at"

i = 0
while i < len(s):
    if i != 0 and i + 2 < len(s) and isDot(i):
        ans += '.'
        i += 3
        continue
    if not used and i != 0 and i + 1 < len(s) and isAt(i):
        ans += '@'
        i += 2
        used = True
        continue
    ans += s[i]
    i += 1

print(ans)
